upcoming_earnings.thesis: Premier AI/cloud platform. Currently $423.88 vs $539.83 ATH (Oct 2025) = -21.5% from peak — rare entry. Azure + Copilot + OpenAI partnership = AI infrastructure leader. $3.04T market cap = bedrock holding.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py MSFT after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Apple Inc.

Services (App Store, iCloud, Apple Intelligence) now 38% of gross profit and growing 14%+ YoY. 2.2B device installed base creates durable lock-in. iPhone supercycle thesis depends on Apple Intelligence adoption. China (-11% YoY) is a headwind. Near 52w high at $313.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AAPL after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: AWS is the #1 AI infrastructure platform with 35% cloud market share and re-accelerating growth (21% YoY). $105B 2025 capex into AI training/inference. Bedrock is the enterprise AI platform of choice for regulated industries. Advertising ($56B, 18% growth) is a high-margin compounder. Near 52w high at -2.4%.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AMZN after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Edison International
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Edison International offers a relatively cheap valuation at 8.7x trailing earnings for a stable utility company with 7.7% YoY revenue growth.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py EIX after.

upcoming_earnings.name: LPL Financial Holdings Inc.

upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py LPLA after.

upcoming_earnings.thesis: Payments toll road like Visa — 61% op margin, 16% growth, 21x fwd PE. -19% from ATH. Every digital transaction pays Mastercard regardless of cycle. Quality compounder on a rare sale.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py MA after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Reddit, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: World's largest forum network. Revenue grew 69% YoY with 91.4% gross margin and 27.6% op margin. $0.56B FCF. 17.4x forward PE — cheapest in this batch relative to growth (PEG <0.3). AI data licensing (Google $60M/yr, OpenAI deal) is a new high-margin revenue layer. -45.5% from $282 ATH at $154 makes the entry compelling. International expansion (historically English-only) is untapped.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py RDDT after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Tradeweb Markets Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Structural winner in fixed-income electronification: 93.6% gross margin, 46.4% op margin, ~21% growth on net cash, priced near ICE/NDAQ despite growing faster. Note this is the other side of the MKTX trade — a swap candidate rather than an addition.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py TW after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Eaton Corporation plc
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Makes electrical switchgear, power distribution, and circuit breakers — the physical infrastructure for datacenter power delivery. Switchgear backlog sold out through 2026. 25.8x forward PE, 16.8% growth, $2.65B FCF. -6.7% from ATH — near peak.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py ETN after.

upcoming_earnings.thesis: Liquid cooling and power distribution inside the data center at ~26x forward for ~28% expected growth (~1x PEG); complements rather than duplicates VRT. Weak spot is FCF conversion consumed by working capital — this is a gross-margin story, not a revenue story.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py NVT after.

upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py BWXT after.

upcoming_earnings.thesis: Record backlog at ~1.6 years of visibility plus a largest-ever data center mega-order, on a debt-free balance sheet with ~30% ROE. But ~34x forward on 6.5% realized growth prices in a backlog conversion and capacity expansion that both still must be executed.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py POWL after.

upcoming_earnings.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: #2 AI GPU company. MI300X deployed at Microsoft Azure, Meta, and Oracle for inference workloads. Key risk: CUDA software moat is 15 years deep — AMD wins on price/performance but requires significant porting effort, limiting ceiling.
upcoming_earnings.action: Review thesis before earnings. Re-run research_ticker.py AMD after.
